verdictScope: readiness of the candidate and of the plan — NOT a promotion. Promotion needs 'APPROVE UI — PREPARE FINAL DOMAIN PROMOTION' and then a separate execution approval.
gap: Production is pre-accounts main@9cd95ff (v2.7.2, no database). The RC carries 9B.1 accounts, 9B.2 career, 9B.3 guided flow, 9C challenges, 9D progression, 9E rating/leaderboards, 9F public profiles, and the Unified Light UI — all currently proven only on the preview database.

blockersForPromotion.item: Create the production Supabase project and apply 0001..0007 (production-migration-plan steps 1-3)
Set production env keys (names in production-migration-plan step 4); never the preview project's values
Flags: CHAOS_CLASH_ENABLED=true; PREVIEW_SIM_ENGINE_ENABLED (Candidate 4 vs production engine 3.2.0)
Merge chain: PR #49 (9F) and the RC PR are open drafts; main must receive the chain in order
Owner test of the RC on its durable preview alias (journeys A-H) and the verdict APPROVE UI

readyNow: Application build at the RC commit (13 serverless functions incl. middleware, budget held)
Shared-token Light Court with the dark global navigation kept
Chaos challenge entry corrected with a regression gate

evidenceLegend.automated: gate or test output recorded in data/validation/ui-release
evidenceLegend.manual-developer: developer drove the preview in a browser
evidenceLegend.owner-reported: the owner said it worked; not independently reproduced
